info.name: LostLink Microservices API
info.description: Item, Claim and User services. Set itemUrl, claimUrl, userUrl (your Render URLs), serviceKey, adminEmail and adminPassword, then run the folders in order with the Collection Runner. Student accounts are created fresh on every run.

body.raw:
{
  "type": "found",
  "title": "Blue Milton water bottle",
  "description": "Steel bottle with a sticker on the cap",
  "category": "Bottle",
  "location": "Central Library, 2nd floor",
  "date": "2026-10-10"
}

{
  "type": "lost",
  "title": "Student ID card",
  "description": "ID card in a red lanyard",
  "category": "ID Card",
  "location": "Main canteen",
  "date": "2026-10-11"
}

item.name: Claim - reporter cannot claim own item (409)
Create claim (checks Item Service, copies profile from User Service)

exec: pm.test('Item title from Item Service', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.itemTitle).to.eql('Blue Milton water bottle'));

item.name: Student sees the question in My claims
Item + claims, public view (Item -> Claim Service)

exec: pm.test('Each claim has item', () => pm.response.json().data.forEach(c => pm.expect(c).to.have.property('item')));
